consistency_quote_audit.explanation: There were 184 structural groups (midpoint YES sum >1) eligible for live checking. The balanced budget requested 20 groups (9 priority, 11 exploration; 193 legs), leaving 164 unrequested/unquoted due group/leg caps (the candidate file labels 44 group-cap and 120 leg-cap cases). Of 20 attempted, 4 returned validated books but no positive basket (quoted_nonpositive); 16 quote attempts failed validation: 7 stale-book responses and 9 markets with no asks. These were CLOB data/validation failures, not recorded HTTP status errors. Another 91 groups had midpoint YES sum <1 and were directional/missing-mass cases, not structural candidates. No candidate was actionable or provisional positive. Scanner explicitly warns outcomePrices midpoints may reflect stale stub bids; incomplete because market_cap and unquoted groups.
